row.notes: Clears root vector +0x280..+0x288 (0xc0 entries); if [+0x2b0]+0x88->+0x260->+0x2b0 byte +0x20b, per entrant ([+0x2a0]+0x1d8..+0x1e0, 0x98 stride) marks garage(<12)/slot(<2), adds root 'garage_%u_slot_%u' (0x141d7cff0), sets driverName/car_number fields (log GARAGE_BOARD_DEBUG createDriverRoot); then empty roots for unused garage/slot pairs; fires 'complete_sync_point' (0x144320fe0).
